name: Wes Moore
stance: Plans to ask the 2027 General Assembly for an AI framework that includes regulations for frontier AI companies alongside child-safety and algorithmic-accountability rules.

statements.text: Unveiled a state AI framework that includes developing regulations for frontier AI companies, to be pursued in the January 2027 session.
AI shouldn't be able to quietly decide who gets a loan, or housing, or healthcare or a government benefit without accountability and a human in the loop

review.note: research pass, September 2026; not yet reviewed
